info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Categories API

params.name: categories
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific part categories. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of categoryIDs.

params.name: name
params.description: This parameter is used to string search part categories names either partial or full name with the wildcard %.

items.docs:
Creates a part category to help you organize your parts.

Parameter: name, Type: string, Required?: Required, Description: The name of your new part category (i.e. "Lawn Mower Parts")

params.name: categoryID
params.description: categoryID of the category you wish to remove.

items.docs:
This request updates a Part Category's name.

Parameter: name, Type: string, Required?: Required, Description: The name of your new part category (i.e. "Filters")

params.name: categoryID
params.description: categoryID of the category you wish to remove.

items.docs: This request will remove the Part Category from all Parts and from possible Categories.
